    num_people=4,
    budget=105,
    gym_present=True,
    breakfast_included=True
)
save_to_cache(key="anchorage_hotels", value=hotels_search)

    city="Anchorage",
    cuisine=["Persian"],
    rating=[3.5, 3.5]
)

# We use the hotel search results as the reference point for proximity
nearest_results = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels_search,
    restaurants=restaurants_search,
    groupBy="restaurant"
)
